args.subject: PHL label confusion: Pellow Home Living / Covey & Lark
args.body:
June,

Note from Sofia Marchetti on the PHL label confusion:

- Pellow Home Living was renamed from Covey & Lark Retail on Feb 16.
- A saved report still reads "Covey — Late Arrivals" and needs its label changed to Pellow Home Living.
- "PHL" is also used for Pellucid Harbor Logistics (Gulf Coast terminal rows), so filtering on "PHL" returns both accounts. Pellow rows are the Mid-Atlantic home goods appointments.

Sent via assistant (Pemberline workspace bot) at Sofia's request.
